title: Pivoting to Cryptography With Purpose: Embracing The Rigor
summary: Reflections on transitioning from general cybersecurity to the rigorous world of cryptography, emphasising the importance of formal definitions, security models and a strong mathematical foundation.

title: Week 1: Foundational Encryption Concepts
summary: An accessible introduction to core encryption principles, comparing symmetric and asymmetric techniques and explaining how keys, plaintext and ciphertext work together in secure communication.
